definition: (PROBE — rejected) ERCOT-116: ercot_thermal_dam_availability_coal armed as the single delta on the ercot115 keeper, answering what the statistical coal-availability model is silently compensating for. The pre-committed SHAPE gates PASS in every year: the matched-price-band excess seasonal lift falls 19.2/18.6/20.6 -> 10.0/12.9/13.4 pp and the Jun-Sep-minus-Feb-Apr monthly-ratio spread narrows +0.435/+0.591/+0.333 -> +0.233/+0.400/+0.230 — roughly half the ~19 pp coal seasonal term IS the statistical availability model's seasonal profile (it misses the measured 10-13 pp summer-vs-shoulder committed-capability asymmetry; real coal takes outages in spring/fall). REJECTED on the level: coal +6.8/+9.2/+12.9 TWh vs the keeper (annual ratio 1.06/1.13/1.15), C3a degrades 5.6-7.6 pp beyond the 2.0 pp gate, C1 COAL_PRB 2025 out of band. The estimate's tight shoulder envelope was masking a within-envelope coal-vs-gas merit-order bias — the successor lane.
